title: adidas FIFA World Cup 26™ Trionda Soccer Ball

reviews.title: Favorite ball
reviews.body: FAVORITE soccer ball hands down! We’ve been through so many soccer balls and this one tops them all. It retains air great. Perfect for the athlete in the family. The colors are beautiful. Easy to pump up. It has lasted with zero issues. Came in great condition. Would buy again but haven’t needed to.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 25, 2026
reviews.author: Coffee Motherhood & Chaos🐆💕

reviews.title: Excellent Soccer Ball forFootball Fans
reviews.body: This soccer ball has an amazing design and captures the excitement of the World Cup. The material quality feels great, with excellent details and a professional look. It is perfect for playing, training, or as a collectible item for soccer fans.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 16, 2026

reviews.title: Fantastic Quality
reviews.body: Fantastic Quality — My Kid Loves It! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐I bought this ball for my kid, and it has been an absolute hit. The quality is fantastic and it feels incredibly durable, easily holding up to hours of hard play on the field and in the backyard.

reviews.author: Marina Laura Marti

reviews.title: Good quality KIDS ball
reviews.body: Kids size, definitely not for adults. Build quality is great for the price. You will need a pump to inflate the ball, but once it’s pumped, it stays full. I will be returning due to the size, other than that, it’s a great ball.

reviews.title: Great quality
reviews.body: The world cup was so fun to watch all the games. It was fun to have a soccer ball, seems like great quality and durable.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 27, 2026
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: Good ball but durability is iffy
reviews.body: It’s a good ball but the issue with it is that the durability is quite low most likely because the ball is white but regardless it shouldn’t  have this many marks with only one week of use. In terms of usability it’s a very nice ball though with great air retention and the grip is very good. Though I would say for the price point you could get a better ball but they have to mark up the price because it’s a World Cup ball.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 3, 2026

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.body: Omg the curve was insane and the design and color was awesome my son loved this ball that he even took it to school it's awesome for kids

reviews.author: Max

reviews.title: Somewhat iIrritated with this purchase. :(
reviews.body: So irritated with this purchase! This ball was a gift for my grandson. It came in a brown box that was partially crushed. The ball itself came totally deflated in two plastic bags…no pump, no box appropriate for gifting, just the deflated ball in big plastic bags. Now I need tofigure out how to pump up the ball (I’ll likely have to buy one!)  and wrap it so it looks like a presentable gift. The ball itself looks new and fine…other than being flat.UPDATE:  After speaking with my son, he let me know that many balls come flat, do that wasn’t an issue. (I’m a 67 year old grandmother who hated giving a flat, un-gift-boxed present as part of my grandson’s birthday 🎁 gift!). My son assured me that my grandson wouldn’t care at all, and they’ll pump it up in 5 minutes. That said, if you don’t care about this issue, it’s a nice ball. The surface is nice and unscathed, and the graphics well done. I gave the review one more star. I do think noting this in the description would be beneficial for the customer.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 3, 2026
reviews.author: Elizabeth

features: Inspired by the iconic "la ola" wave among the crowd, the adidas FIFA World Cup 26 Trionda League Soccer Ball features a seamless TSBE surface for precise touch and reduced water uptake. A butyl bladder ensures shape retention.
TSBE TECHNOLOGY: Seamless surface for better touch and lower water uptake
KEEPS ITS SHAPE: Butyl bladder for best air retention
REQUIRES INFLATION: Ships flat, pump not included
FIFA QUALITY AND OFFICIALLY LICENSED: Officially licensed by FIFA, the ball passed FIFA tests on circumference, weight, rebound and water absorption
